# AgentRank Audit

AgentRank Audit is a self-serve AI search readiness scanner for SaaS teams, SEO consultants, and agencies.

## Key Pages

- Product: /
- Pricing: /#pricing
- Launch Kit: /#launch
- OAI-SearchBot Checker: /tools/oai-searchbot-checker/
- Claude-SearchBot Checker: /tools/claude-searchbot-checker/
- PerplexityBot Checker: /tools/perplexitybot-checker/
- Google-Extended Checker: /tools/google-extended-checker/
- llms.txt Limitations: /guides/llms-txt-limitations/
- Sample Report: /sample-agentrank-audit.md

## Scope

The tool checks robots.txt, sitemap.xml, llms.txt, JSON-LD, metadata, headings, and crawlable high-value links. It treats llms.txt as an optional content map, not as a guaranteed ranking signal.
